title: Project Update Meeting
discussion_points: The wireframe for the new onboard flow is complete but needs revisions based on design team feedback.
Revisions for the wireframe will take about three to four days.
Anas's team can start the back end setup in parallel, needing about a week.
Omar proposed an AI solution for automating meeting minutes.
Omar needs access to Azure speech API and SharePoint templates to create a proof of concept.
The Q3 budget review deadline for department estimates is set for Friday.
decisions: Sarah will revise the wireframe and have it ready by Thursday.
Anas's team will start working on the back end.
Omar will create a proof of concept for the AI solution within two weeks.
Everyone must submit their department budget estimates by Friday.

Start setting up the API endpoints for the back end
Create a proof of concept for the AI meeting intelligence agent

follow_ups: Check on the status of the wireframe revisions by Thursday.
Monitor the progress of the back end setup by Anas's team.
